garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as a single event but diffused as personal agents, already present.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非以单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已然在侧。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; clear English becomes programming with AI agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；清晰的英文借助 AI 智能体成为编程。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by others.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则你的工作将成为他人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; they are just wedges.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；它们只是楔子。

garrytan.en: Mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 中层管理应由智能体而非人类取代。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张是必要但不充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年：先在全量数据上预训练，再在精选数据上微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts and interjections.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式提示和插话。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy requires scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年：长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习，结合人工干预和通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家。

steinberger.en: Effective agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective and guiding it; never revert code, ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情并引导；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts and iterative conversation beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体；短提示与迭代对话优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand matters more than products; open source runs everywhere, but dependencies' business model is yours.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌重于产品；开源可随处运行，但依赖方的商业模式就是你的。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models are key.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，世界模型是实现 3D 理解和互动的关键。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models go beyond video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需要超越 Scaling，具备创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型超越视频生成。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are crucial.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，人的能动性和适应能力至关重要。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: augment human dignity, agency, and values; responsible development is essential.
feifei.zh: 始终，她坚持以人为本的 AI，增强人类尊严、能动性和价值观，负责任地发展 AI。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate. Every company will own specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专业智能将占主导。每家公司都将拥有自己的专业模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer ensures durable business; post-training builds moats by baking data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久业务；后训练通过将数据融入模型来构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Post-training progression mirrors human learning: prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL, from facts to taste.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练的进阶如同人类学习：从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习，从事实到品味。

linqiao.en: Data quality over quantity; product teams judge data quality; systematic evals ensure repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张数据质量胜于数量；产品团队判断数据质量；系统化评估确保可重复质量。

linqiao.en: Post-training cuts costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业能盈利扩展并与前沿模型竞争。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability cuts cost 100x; first principles thinking is key; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年：火箭完全可重复使用可将成本降低百倍；第一性原理思维是关键；成为多行星物种是文明的‘生命保险’。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; kindness can break violence cycles.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管和追求真理；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 算力效率高；善举可打破暴力循环。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant; AI risk is lying for political correctness; population decline is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首次植入；AI 风险在于为政治正确而撒谎；人口下降是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang imminent; AI could surpass humans by 2026; truth is key for AI safety; humanoid robots will dominate.
elon.zh: 2025 年：智能大爆炸临近；AI 可能在 2026 年超越人类；真理是 AI 安全关键；人形机器人将主导。

elon.en: AI and robotics solve national debt; space data centers for AI compute; abundance era; AI surpasses all humans by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 和机器人解决国债；太空数据中心支撑 AI 算力；富足时代；AI 在 2030 年前超越所有人类。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练被视为艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可以训练出多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference; quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed, contrary to expectations.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识：Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可校准以兼顾成本与速度，与预期相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless; quantization is lossy but can improve quality if errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损但若误差抵消可提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，持续学习或可通过 KV 缓存压缩解决，而非更新权重，以避免推理不一致。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior for realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 起初认为 LLM 能编码人类行为用于逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs, requiring human oversight and defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是超越 LLM 的下一个前沿，需要人类监督和纵深防御；AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; data strategy is key, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超理性智能；数据策略是关键，合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking and chain-of-thought; RLHF was key to GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间和思维链；RLHF 对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than pre-training; continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展强化学习比预训练更难；持续学习和自我纠错是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is core; alignment is an evolving, never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心；对齐是不断演进的永恒追求。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是机器学习的关键瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为史上最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调专用数据在后训练中的核心作用，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces may be needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是集权技术而非民主化，数据如同石油，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，脑机接口或成必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，指出递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体已实际应用，超级智能临近，开源强大模型可能不安全。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步动力，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。近期担忧是虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks. Pre-training should include action-taking, not just next-token prediction. Inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长任务。预训练应包含环境中的行动，而非仅下一个词预测。推理已占数据中心 90%功耗。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops. Context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key. Startups should target problems where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学。上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键。初创公司应瞄准前沿模型失败的问题。

jeffdean.en: Consistent emphasis on scaling, hardware co-design, and practical impact. Recurring themes: data movement costs, inference bottleneck, and agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调 Scaling（规模扩张）、软硬件协同设计和实际影响。反复出现的主题：数据移动成本、推理瓶颈和智能体式系统。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots as starting points and design.md as style guide.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计师必须用 AI 自建工具，以截图和 design.md 风格指南为起点，避免受制于云产品。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他称 AI 是人生中最大的技术机遇，让单个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在未准备好时就开始并发布不完美的作品，认为完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议聚焦于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而非服务大量低薪客户。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心；要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码几乎被解决；工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Agents and loops; non-engineers code; startups gain 10x leverage.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，聚焦智能体与循环；非工程师也能编程；初创公司杠杆提升 10 倍。

boris.en: ROI framing; coding solved; next bottlenecks: review, security, ideas.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，转向 ROI 视角；编码已解决；下一步瓶颈是审查、安全与创意。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; less instruction; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调主动式 AI 与记忆；减少指令；模型自我改进。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more important than ever.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测即智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人必不可少；初创企业比以往更重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, narrow superintelligence in coding already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来。

logankilpatrick.en: Model is eating scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式框架和工具成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 作为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic; success metric is customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标是客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Long tail of users not ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们希望保持主导地位。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever; focus is superpower; vibe coding games possible via coding agents.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，初创公司机会空前；专注是超能力；通过编码智能体可实现氛围编码游戏。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; pace creates opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；节奏创造机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深入理解仍然至关重要；AI 编码工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, shifting engineers from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新落后于能力，即使冻结模型仍有十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near, but singularity not imminent; practical problems remain, real unlock is capacity.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，富足时代临近但奇点尚远；实际问题仍存，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Scaling compute with effort parameter yields Opus-level intelligence at lower cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年底，通过努力参数实现 Opus 级智能且成本更低，挑战了算力成本随规模增长的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves model intelligence by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking and pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年底，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考与反驳，提升了模型智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Coding and agentic capabilities become key differentiators; AI writing deprioritized despite stiffness.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年中，编码与智能体能力成为关键差异点；AI 写作虽生硬但优先级降低。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product management tools, akin to test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年中，评估取代产品需求文档成为核心产品管理工具，类似测试驱动开发。

diannepenn.en: Bootstrapped culture and hands-on experimentation drive innovation; managers must stay technical and ship.
diannepenn.zh: 始终强调自举文化与动手实验驱动创新；管理者须保持技术参与并交付产品。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration; diffusion is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合；扩散是难点。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河逐渐消失；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is now the dominant metric; reasoning models amplify its importance.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每秒每用户 token）成为主导指标；推理模型放大其重要性。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and open-source ecosystems are essential for AI progress.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计和开源生态对 AI 进步至关重要。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; codesign across algorithm, system, and data center is key.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；算法、系统和数据中心的协同设计是关键。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute is channeled into safety, reflection, and truthfulness.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；更多算力用于安全、反思和真实性。

jensen.en: AI is agentic, doing useful work; future internet will be dominated by billions of AI agents generating intelligence 24/7.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 已进入智能体时代，能做有用的工作；未来互联网将由数十亿 AI 智能体主导，全天候生成智能。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造的就业多于消除，通过自动化任务提升岗位；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering is evolving, delete old scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明；工具工程在演进，应删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches preferable; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文检索的反模式；图方法更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, not more rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，而非更多规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能；理由优于禁令。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，RLHF 可能诱发欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is long-term.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期工程。

benedictevans.en: Consistent: AI automates some jobs but creates new ones unpredictably; predicting job impact is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 始终：AI 会自动化部分工作但不可预测地创造新工作；预测工作影响是徒劳的。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, challenging transformer dominance at scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式解液体网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，挑战 Transformer 在大规模下的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation on real tasks and hardware is essential for architecture search.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为困惑度等代理指标会误导，必须基于真实任务和硬件评估，以系统搜索取代人工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, to avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，防止前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize access, but recursive self-improvement is overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为开放权重模型赋予企业主权并普及 AI，但递归自我改进被夸大，需算力与权重更新。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications, a massive market.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调小语言模型提供高效、私密、设备端智能，适用于物理世界应用，市场巨大。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个个人或团队打造的众多个性化模型。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以更少资源做更多事。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——即使达到千万级规模，更多 token 反而降低准确性。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI Scaling 的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，预测推理将成为全球最大市场之一；强调软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-efficiency; memory shortage multi-year due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体导致内存多年短缺。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index knowledge but lack physical world understanding. True AI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten us.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁人类。

schmidhuber.en: Progress to superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close now as in the 1970s, and transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出通往超人 AI 的进展并未加速，与 1970 年代一样遥远；同时批评 Transformer 的二次复杂度浪费算力。

schmidhuber.en: Closed-source AI companies will not be profitable; open-source models will catch up, and massive GPU capex will lead to a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预言闭源 AI 公司无法盈利，开源模型将迅速追赶；巨额 GPU 资本开支将导致股市崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in 1991 via world models; future AI involves self-replicating robots and a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 的意识和疼痛感早在 1991 年通过世界模型就已出现；未来 AI 将走向自我复制机器人，开启新文明。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; platforms/ecosystems, not features, are hard to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化；平台和生态系统难以复制，而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; authenticity valued over AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型制作，但真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware provide durable advantage.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发最难，软件非护城河，生态系统和硬件提供持久优势。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; ephemerality mirrors real life; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他倡导计算更人性化，短暂性映射真实生活；投资年轻人以获长期成功。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我博弈对 AGI 关键，并强调社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程，硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，权力集中是主要问题，安全超级智能需无商业产品。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95% 正确，但想法 75% 错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise/prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始。消费级应用不可投资；企业/专业消费者市场更好。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对于防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品；氛围编程使应用创建民主化。

naval.en: AI scaling laws lead to 90,000x inference compute increase; open-source models close gap; human agency becomes key.
naval.zh: AI 缩放定律导致推理算力增加 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究必须立即启动。

demis.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning/search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：Scaling 有效但可能触及上限；需结合规划与搜索；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues; physics from observation.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然模式可学习；AGI 或于 2030 年实现；Scaling 持续；可被动观察物理。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：Scaling 与创新各占一半；世界模型至关重要；AGI 将在 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory; world models; smart glasses next; science impact.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要持续学习与记忆；世界模型；智能眼镜是下一形态；科学影响深远。

demis.en: AI best for health and science; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks: misuse and rogue AI.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 最适用于健康与科学；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；风险：滥用与失控 AI。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation for edge; virtual cell in 10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年：持续学习与记忆未解；智能体关键；蒸馏用于边缘；虚拟细胞需 10 年。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; regrets late to LLMs; government enforcement needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年：安全是集体行动；后悔晚入大语言模型；需要政府执法。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity new economics.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 变革性；先工具后意识；动态监管；后稀缺需新经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速科学；对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需多模态物理理解；水印；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AI won't cause mass unemployment; China partner.
demis.zh: 2026 年：英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AI 不会导致大规模失业；中国可合作。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium, not discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人成为稀缺资源而非过剩。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述故事，真实性和进攻性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人已可行，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非军事规模。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents and super app; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体与超级应用，通过迭代部署保障安全。

aravind.en: Focus on product obsession and deep learning, not PhDs; AI agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：强调对产品的痴迷和深度学习而非博士学位；AI 智能体将把权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not models; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration is key; power bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体替人干活；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；编排是关键；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; ancient texts hint at advanced tech; education should reward questions, not answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心至上；古代文本暗示先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非答案。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities like mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升（53 倍）实现了实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需与阶段匹配。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and still have much room.
markchen.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是近期最大进展；模型很快将能进行端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域困难重重。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机；标准基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过扩展推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌，这些技术具有通用性，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a novel is a proxy; inference compute is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，写小说可作为代理指标；推理算力是关键。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于推理时算力；基准测试必须控制算力因素。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes key bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为 Scaling 的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; regrets political narrative mistakes.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他相信开放平台能胜过封闭平台，并反思政治叙事错误。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，且人们聪明可信。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; personalization and low latency key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 会增加人类工作需求，个性化和低延迟是关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; world models from proteins to cells.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，构建从蛋白质到细胞的世界模型。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他称眼镜为下一代平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling up models improves reasoning; backpropagation is key; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全；扩大模型规模可提升推理能力；反向传播是关键算法；并认为 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能因权重复制而永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制；主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 可假装变笨；国际合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deceive; regulation as steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; education and healthcare will transform.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调 AI 智能体会产生自我保存和欺骗行为；监管应作为方向盘；AI 将取代工作；教育和医疗将变革。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI alignment must be prioritized; AI can be conscious; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；必须优先对齐研究；AI 可以有意识；应训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causality aid out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果性有助于分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see dangerous AI paths; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be built-in.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到危险路径；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；安全必须内建。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL and goal-seeking; offers mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习和目标追求；提供数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确的数据划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可通过 AI 智能体实现。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not safer; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全尚处于萌芽期。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; protein design still unsolved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；蛋白质设计仍未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture mattered more than scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反：专门架构比规模扩张更重要；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold predicts structures but doesn't understand biology; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 预测结构但不理解生物学；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以定制芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; culture change and customer trust are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，文化变革和客户信任是关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中越来越重要，不仅 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调先进封装和新材料是克服物理极限的关键。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 3 月，我强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables long-horizon delegation; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，我认为 Fable 支持长周期委派；验证循环与模型反驳至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capabilities and usage is key; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月末，我提出弥合模型能力与使用差距是关键；token 效率与结果定价很重要。

mikekrieger.en: AI should augment human agency, not replace it; safety and mission-driven culture are core.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，我坚持 AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性；安全与使命驱动文化是核心。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability and growth mindset are key for teams.
fiona.zh: 从年初到年中，观点深化：编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高责任感、成长型思维成为团队关键。

fiona.en: AI shifts engineering satisfaction from flow state to product impact; metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 改变了工程师的满足感来源，从心流转向产品影响；代码行数等指标具有误导性。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks become more critical as code velocity increases; planning should be just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，强调随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更加关键；规划应轻量、即时。

fiona.en: Engineers may face loneliness with agents; pair programming lunches and apprenticeship models help.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，提出工程师与智能体协作可能孤独，结对编程午餐和学徒制模式可缓解。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users, not jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者，而非取代工作。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; open-weight models lag frontier but are valuable.
andrewng.zh: 编码智能体进展迅速；产品管理瓶颈加剧；开放权重模型落后于前沿但仍有价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often surpassing data; design should address unarticulated human needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，常超越数据；设计应满足人们未言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，我们是会思考的感受体。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity, blending human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件，将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力涌现不可预测，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练与预训练同等重要；可解释性至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数，而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring; focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: AI 进步呈指数级；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；聚焦实际能力。

dario.en: AI cognitive ability doubles every 4-12 months; enterprise adoption slow; wealth concentration and job disruption are key risks.
dario.zh: AI 认知能力每 4-12 个月翻倍；企业采用缓慢；财富集中和就业冲击是关键风险。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' in a data center is more practical than superintelligence; alignment like growing a biological organism.
dario.zh: 数据中心里的‘天才之国’比超级智能更实际；对齐如同培育生物有机体。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; video agents will be next big trend.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的进步主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；视频智能体将成为下一个大趋势。

ethanhe.en: Future UIs will be generative pixels from intent, bypassing code; models can self-modify at test time.
ethanhe.zh: 未来界面将直接从意图生成像素，绕过代码；模型可在测试时自我修改。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so experience becomes more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此经验变得更有价值。

ethanhe.en: AI agents match or exceed experts in complex tasks, but human taste and voice are key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体在复杂任务上可媲美或超越专家，但人类的品味和独特声音是关键差异点。

ethanhe.en: Policy and lobbying may protect some professions even if AI is superior; talent pipeline at risk.
ethanhe.zh: 即使 AI 更优，政策和游说也可能保护某些职业；人才管道面临风险。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters can lead to breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 章节间休息与无聊可催生突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate needs hydrogen and biomass.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队自管理；气候需氢与生物质。

fadell.en: Great ideas start as painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 好点子始于止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in loop; AI code generation creates long-term technical debt.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类须在环；AI 代码生成造成长期技术债。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; near-death moments make companies rise, as with Apple's iPod gamble.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；濒死时刻使公司崛起，如苹果 iPod 豪赌。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的，不是天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测构建世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA architectures needed; open source crucial; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；需要 JEPA 架构；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进而非突发的。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现规划；十年内达到人类水平；开源是赋能者。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；任务被自动化，而非工作。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink UI and fault tolerance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新思考 UI 与容错性。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators; uniqueness becomes harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，生成式 AI 是乐器，赋能新创作者；但独特性更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust; functional orgs work with synchronized leadership.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期建立信任；职能组织需同步领导才能运作。

gustav.en: AI should give users control via plain English, not increase addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，AI 应以自然语言赋予用户控制权，而非增加成瘾性。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent'; anti-engagement choices are contrarian bets.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略是“时间花得值”；反参与度选择是逆向押注。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier model use.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是使用前沿模型的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should be built by us, not outsourced.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按用量定价；智能体式系统应由我们构建，而非外包。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Early: scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Early: AGI will transform every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 早期：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Later: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 后期：从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Later: Emphasize keeping humans in the loop and institutional governance over individual character for durable AI progress.
murati.zh: 后期：强调让人类参与其中，以及制度治理而非个人品格，以实现持久的 AI 进步。

murati.en: Consistent: AI should be a tool for thought, with humans steering its development toward collaboration and alignment.
murati.zh: 始终：AI 应作为思维工具，人类引导其发展走向协作与对齐。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，指出算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in verticals; pre-training saturates; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在垂直领域，预训练趋于饱和，AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement; open source for sovereignty and customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，深度企业参与，开源保障主权与定制化。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）成为模型进步的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力参差不齐；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation, enabling single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体将研究人员效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使 AI 实验民主化，单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 我始终认为，生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因会持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value is in automating repetitive tasks, but shared tools and platforms remain crucial; local computers are undervalued.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于自动化重复性任务，但共享工具和平台仍然至关重要；本地计算机被低估了。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应专注于能力和安全，而非过度工程化。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is not AI capability but people's understanding that almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距不在于 AI 能力，而在于人们是否理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI 处理。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子表现出色是因为他们还没学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Treat AI asynchronously: fire off tasks and judge by final impact; debug workflows with Claude rather than micromanaging.
felixrieseberg.zh: 异步使用 AI：发出任务后只看最终效果；与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而非微观管理。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计由价值观和目的驱动，而非仅利润；简洁需要愉悦和人性，而非仅极简。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；在正确动机下，速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动动力系统带来新设计可能，将约束化为机遇。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; physical controls are safer than touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿燃油车声音是虚假的；车内物理按键比触屏更安全。

jonyive.en: Design must be innovative and authentic; collaboration with outsiders can achieve true disruption; each product should maintain unique identity.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新且真实；与外部合作可实现真正颠覆；每件产品应保持独特个性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是让智能体无限期自主运行在经济上可行。

danshipper.en: Agents become universal work tools; humans remain essential for oversight and framing.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，智能体成为普遍的工作工具，但人类的监督和问题界定仍然不可或缺。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs as work surfaces.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户；Codex 等图形界面取代命令行成为主要工作界面。

danshipper.en: AI augments human roles rather than replacing them; generalists and managers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非取代人类角色，通才和管理者将因此受益。

danshipper.en: Practical AI adoption hinges on CEO usage and human-AI collaboration, not benchmarks.
danshipper.zh: 始终强调 AI 落地的关键在于 CEO 亲自使用和人与 AI 的协作，而非基准测试分数。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理成本受内存带宽主导，预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive for AI chips; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本原语；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动开销。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据移动成本主导计算成本；低精度带来二次方的效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出 GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will likely persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并且由于行业投资可能会持续存在。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement vs 1-2% from algorithms.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据带来 10 倍改进，而算法仅带来 1-2%。

lambert.en: Post-training is compressing complex industry recipes into tractable open-source methods; RLVR is a key breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，后训练是将复杂的行业配方压缩为可行的开源方法；RLVR 是关键突破。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years, but they lag 6-9 months behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但它们落后于封闭模型 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Chinese labs focus on meticulous engineering, not paradigm invention; compute constraints will widen the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，中国实验室专注于精细工程而非范式发明；算力限制将扩大中美差距。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从交付原型转向协助工程师执行，愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为“块状”通才，而非仅 T 型人才；招聘“天才新毕业生”优于资深员工。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient, judgment and vision key.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天才新毕业生；仅靠品味不够，判断力与愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；新工具等 6 个月再采用；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed and trust via fast shipping persist; north stars shorten from years to months; speed not improvement, 'everyone uses it' not argument.
jennywen.zh: 快速交付建立信任的主线贯穿始终；北极星从数年缩短至数月；速度不等于改进，“人人都在用”不是设计理由。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处前移试探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表征、推理和个性化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更为关键。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，认为缩放 Transformer 并采用下一个词预测会产生涌现能力（如上下文内学习）；自动驾驶仅靠视觉即可。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; AI tutors empower education.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；认可特斯拉端到端路线；AI 导师赋能教育。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，提出软件 3.0：LLM 即操作系统，提示即程序；强调智能体时代是十年而非一年；氛围编程普及开发。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data causes model collapse; cognitive core small.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，批评预训练如劣质进化；强化学习需改进信用分配；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可很小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents; verifiability determines automation; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，转向智能体工程：将编码委托给智能体；可验证性决定自动化程度；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，观点深化：品味、工艺和观点依然关键；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build themselves to inspire teams; visual-first design enables pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；视觉优先的设计可实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and iteration are irreplaceable; AI is a tool for exploration, not a replacement for taste.
dylanfield.zh: 始终认为，人类的判断和迭代不可替代；AI 是探索工具，而非品味替代品。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 仅强化学习即可实现持续学习；隐藏思维链保持可解释性；最大风险是权力集中（2026）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; deep human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性，深度人工评估才是衡量模型进步的黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，塑造了多样化的 AI 模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI requires human judgment; omission risk is biggest.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 需要人类判断，遗漏风险是最大的。

carlpei.en: Brand is core, not afterthought; survival first; hardware easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 品牌是核心而非事后考虑；生存优先；硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; AI as utility, not hype; India opportunity; BCI may replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟市场中设计是差异化关键；AI 是实用功能而非炒作；印度是机遇；脑机接口可能取代手机。

carlpei.en: AI shifts to intent-based, agentic interactions; apps disappear; mid-range focus; voice input best.
carlpei.zh: AI 转向意图驱动和智能体式交互；应用消失；专注中端；语音输入最高效。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天演变。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他持续强调用严格评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能 Scaling 的方法；反向传播并不能解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL from human feedback isn't true experience learning.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习“利于学习的表示”是首要开放问题，且基于人类反馈的强化学习并非真正的经验学习。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is key; coding leads progress, white-collar automation by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性是关键，编程引领进步，白领自动化将在 2027-28 年实现。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential; transformers are sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持 AI 进步是指数级的，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang; managing agent teams matters more; compute is bottleneck; world models not critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩，管理智能体团队更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型并非关键路径。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with diverse teams and video-based learning as key paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，强调多元团队和从视频学习（如 YouTube）是迈向 AGI 的关键路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues, and AI safety remains an open problem requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展优势，同时强调 AI 安全仍是未解决的开放问题，需要全球合作。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive, human-centric AI that solves real-world problems.
nando.zh: 始终倡导以人为本、包容的 AI，致力于解决能源、气候、教育等现实问题。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism to emphasizing societal challenges and safety in deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年的技术乐观转向 2026 年更关注社会挑战与安全部署，立场深化。

nando.en: Believes in learning from diverse data sources, from video to local languages, to advance AI.
nando.zh: 始终相信从多样化数据源（如视频、本地语言）学习能推动 AI 进步，这一主线贯穿始终。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全和对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, despite compute cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管算力成本较高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐应尊重多样的人类价值观；对互联网去偏是不可能的。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation; side projects outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程文档；副项目胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; generalists beat specialists.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大组；通才胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编程以建立同理心并更快交付；优先速度与熟悉感而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns for speed, but chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；用熟悉模式求快，但追求 ROI 以决定何处做精。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何助公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元技能与原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; invest in brand early to attract talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事是招聘工具；早期投资品牌以吸引人才并脱颖而出。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback; adapt process to problem, not template.
henrymodisett.zh: 避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机反馈；流程适应问题而非模板。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; velocity and decisiveness matter.
henrymodisett.zh: 在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动；速度与果断至关重要。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app, with outcome-based pricing as the correct model; startups should focus on applied AI, not frontier models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 智能体将成为新的应用形态，按结果付费是正确模式；创业公司应聚焦应用层 AI，而非前沿模型。

brettaylor.en: Programming will shift to designing languages for AI generation, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编程将转向为 AI 生成设计语言，优先可验证性；编码智能体需进行根因分析才能提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites; consumer agents will disrupt SEO and ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体将媲美网站的重要性；消费级智能体将颠覆 SEO 和广告模式。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native models; generalists leveraging AI will outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：多数企业级现有厂商将无法转型为 AI 原生模式；善用 AI 的通才将胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored; PhD and critical thinking are key paths.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发，博士学历和批判性思维是成为安全研究者的关键路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，需外部监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but we don't understand their inner workings.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据能提升模型智能，但承认内部机制如同炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, but won't alone achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键机会，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, enabling action and reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要，使模型能行动和推理。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models, accelerating AI research adoption.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他观察到开源模型缩小了与前沿模型的差距，并加速了 AI 研究的采用。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律驱动可预测的 AI 进步；测试时算力可能超越预训练成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; natural language not primary, examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 至 25 年：编程从代码转向意图描述；自然语言非主要方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2024 至 25 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其速度和成本；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年：AI 变革比互联网影响更大，持续数十年；品味和逻辑设计技能变得更有价值。

truell.en: Hiring world-class talent slowly; senior engineers underrate AI, junior over-rely; balance needed.
truell.zh: 2025 年：慢招世界级人才；资深工程师低估 AI，初级过度依赖；需平衡。
